name: Guidelite Assistant
author: guidelite.ai

sections.description:
GuideLite’s AI assistant integrates effortlessly to deliver real-time customer support and engagement directly on your WordPress website. This plugin utilizes GuideLite.ai’s cutting-edge AI capabilities to respond to user queries, navigate them through your site, and offer prompt assistance.

External Services

This plugin uses an external service provided by GuideLite.ai to enable AI-driven chatbot functionality on your WordPress website.

  • Service Name: GuideLite.ai
  • Purpose: To deliver AI-based customer support and engagement by fetching chatbot configurations and responses.
  • Data Sent:
    • The Assistant ID (Chat ID) is sent to the GuideLite.ai API when the [show_assistant_data] shortcode is used or when the chatbot script is loaded on the frontend.
  • Data Received:
    • Chatbot configurations, responses, and functionality scripts required for operation.
  • API Endpoint Used: https://api.guidelite.ai/webhook/api/v1/wordpress/getAssistantByID/
    • Purpose: Fetches configuration data and responses using the Assistant ID.
  • Privacy and Terms:
    • Terms and Conditions
    • Privacy Policy
  • Data Security: All data transmissions are encrypted, and the plugin complies with GDPR and other relevant privacy regulations.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/guidelite-chatbot directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings->Guidelite Chatbot screen to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
What is the GuideLite WordPress plugin?

The GuideLite WordPress plugin is an advanced AI assistant tool that integrates seamlessly with GuideLite.ai to provide real-time customer support and engagement on your WordPress site.

How does the GuideLite plugin improve customer engagement?

The plugin leverages GuideLite.ai’s AI capabilities to answer user inquiries, guide visitors through your website, and offer instant support, enhancing the overall user experience.

How do I install the GuideLite plugin on my WordPress site?

To install the plugin:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/guidelite-chatbot directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
3. Use the Settings->Guidelite Chatbot screen to configure the plugin.

What are the system requirements for using the GuideLite plugin?

The plugin is compatible with WordPress versions 5.0 and above and requires an active GuideLite.ai account to function properly.

Can the AI assistant handle multiple user queries simultaneously?

Yes, the AI assistant is designed to manage multiple user interactions concurrently, ensuring smooth and efficient support.

Is the plugin customizable to match my website’s branding?

Absolutely! You can customize the AI assistant’s appearance, tone, and response patterns to align with your brand’s style and voice.

How does the plugin ensure data privacy and security?

The plugin adheres to strict privacy protocols, including encryption and GDPR compliance, ensuring user data is handled securely.

Can I track user interactions and performance metrics with the plugin?

Yes, the plugin provides analytics that helps you monitor user interactions, identify trends, and measure engagement effectiveness.

Is technical support available for the GuideLite plugin?

Yes, our team offers dedicated support for installation, configuration, and troubleshooting issues. You can reach out through support@guidelite.ai for assistance.

Does the plugin support multilingual websites?

Yes, the GuideLite plugin supports multiple languages, allowing you to provide AI-driven assistance to a global audience.
